sections.section: RULES - Supreme Court Judges (Travelling Allowance) Rules 1958
sections.description:
SUPREME COURT JUDGES (TRAVELLING
SUPREME COURT JUDGES (TRAVELLING
ALLOWANCE) RULES, 1958
(Amendments of R.5(1))
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary Part II,
19th June, 2013]
S.R.O.
582(I)/2013, dated 19-6-2013.---In pursuance of paragraph 2 of the Fifth
Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan relating to
the Supreme Court of Pakistan, the President is pleased to direct that the
following further amendments shall be made in the Supreme Court Judges
(Traveling Allowance) Rules 1958 and shall be deemed to have been so made from
first day of July, 2012, namely:-
In
the aforesaid Rules in rule 5, in sub-rule (1),-
(a) in
clause (c), for the words "six rupees" the words "twelve
rupees" shall be substituted; and
(b) in
clause (e), for the figure "3000", wherever occurring, the figure
"5000" shall be substituted.
